NAME: SLIDE_KERNEL_PAGE_SETUP_ATTEMPTS

COMPATIBILITY_CRITERION: Repeated eligible setups complete within the cap with an acceptable terminal distribution
INCOMPATIBILITY_CRITERION: Repeated eligible setups exhaust the cap before required state
INCONCLUSIVE_CONDITION: Setup state or attempt attribution unavailable
REQUIRED_OBSERVABLE: Per-attempt setup state and terminal reason
CONFOUNDERS: Allocator pressure; reclaim profile; discovery state
